text: The Black Pyramid’s shadow stirs with Arkhan’s sorcery, raising the Shamblers—silent, ceaseless, and cursed beyond reckoning.
Forged in shadow, bound in death, the Nagashizzar Guard stand unyielding—eternal sentinels of the Great Necromancer’s will.
There are places in Nehekhara where even the Tomb Kings fear to tread—the lairs of the Blackened Claws, where sacred dead find no rest, defiled by hunger.
Sand swirls in their wake, hooves leaving no trace—spears find only mist, until ghostly blades bite cold and true.
Once a temple guardian, now a decaying horror, it knows no rest—each beat of its rotting wings spreads ruin.
